text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — P1 alert for Meteorix (org: meteorix-prod). Sudden spike in 5xxs and org-level RL hits. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/xyz | alert: 5xx_rate > 5% for 3m
jordan: Paging SREs — seeing sustained QPS ~3x baseline, org throttle at 1200r/s -> lots of 502s. Customer-facing errors up. Can we do an emergency org RL bump or short bypass? Need to avoid downstream cascading failures.
sylvia: I’m oncall, looking now. Do we want org-level bump or per-key increase? Any SLA constraints?
jordan: org-level is easiest, single org causing the issue. Current: 1200r/s steady cap. Observed peak ~3500r/s. Suggest temporary raise to 6000r/s with 30m TTL and monitor.
nate: Prefer controlled increase + enable burst allowance rather than unlimited. Also consider routing some traffic to secondary region if capacity spared. I can stand up a secondary route if needed.
jordan: good call. For now let's do org bump + enable prefix KV cache for heavy prompt patterns. Alex from Meteorix confirms they can throttle at client side if we ask.
sylvia: executing emergency change now — running command:
```
redwoodctl rate adjust --org meteorix-prod --limit 6000 --burst 8000 --ttl 30m --reason "prod spike emergency"
```
sylvia: executed. Waiting for deploy-bot confirmation. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: Rate limit updated: org=meteorix-prod new_limit=6000r/s burst=8000 ttl=30m updated_by=sylvia ts=4862101252
alex.meteorix: seeing errors drop on our side, 502s falling to single-digit %, connections recovering. Thanks.
jordan: nice. Keep an eye on token burn and latency. If token cost spikes, we may need to enable samplers or reduce model size for that org.
nate: monitoring dashboards now — QPS trending down to 2.8k, 5xxs <1.5%. I'll take first-line for the next 4 hours and own the TTL expiration. Planning a gradual rollback in 20m increments unless spike reappears.
sylvia: handing off to nate for night coverage. I'll file the follow-up action item: investigate root cause with Meteorix (query pattern), add per-org graceful degradation, and propose a default short-burst policy.
jordan: please capture exact metrics and customer impact for postmortem. Add incident tag: meteorix-emergency-rl.
nate: ack. I'll keep this thread updated and if TTL expires I'll either extend 30m or start a rollback.
sylvia: after-action note: change was approved by oncall due to customer impact. No config drift expected. Will open a ticket in the backlog. :white_check_mark:
jordan: thanks everyone — good coordination.
__notes: Single-thread Slack export. Messages are in chronological order and prefixed with sender names. No title field per agents.md.
